summary: Iteration 64 — Super-admin Phase 3 (AI Copilot / Command Assist), Phase 4 (Cmd/Ctrl+K palette), and Phase 5 (Automation Builder) end-to-end verification on desktop 1920x1080. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green (copilot snapshot auth + shape, SSE stream with open+delta+done events, session reset, automations meta, full CRUD lifecycle, invalid trigger/action rejection, missing-rule 404, and enterprise_lead_created dispatch hook triggers a live run against admin_automation_runs). Frontend: copilot-trigger opens copilot-panel from the right, header shows 'Command Assist · Claude Sonnet 4.5 · grounded in live metrics', all 5 starter prompts present, sending the data-grounding query 'How many total users and how many new enterprise leads are unresponded to?' returned a real Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply ('**91 total users**, **3 new enterprise leads**...') — reply contained numbers AND mentioned users/lead. copilot-reset clears messages, ESC/X closes the drawer. Cmd-K opens cmdk-root + cmdk-panel with cmdk-input focused and 'esc' kbd hint visible; typing 'ithr' returns Users + Organizations sections; typing 'agent' + Enter jumped URL to /admin?tab=agentos and highlighted tab-agentos. Automations tab renders hero copy 'Wire platform events to actions — no code required.', RULES ENGINE pill, automation-create-btn, and automation-empty state ('No automations yet'). 3-step modal (Name→Conditions→Actions) creates a rule with trigger enterprise_lead_created + condition bundle contains talent + action send_slack_message text 'New lead {{email}} · {{bundle}}'; rule row shows ACTIVE pill. Toggle flips DISABLED→ACTIVE with toast; Test fires 'Dry-run · conditions did NOT match' toast (payload {bundle:'sample-bundle'} does not contain 'talent' — expected behaviour); Expand renders the 3 stage cards (Trigger/Conditions/Actions) + Recent runs. Second rule persists across page reload. Regression: sidebar collapse, notification bell, profile menu, cc-quick-emails → Send email tab all still work.

minor.issue: log_activity() called with unexpected keyword argument 'target_id' (see /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Side-effect only — does not fail the POST or block the enterprise_lead_created automation dispatch, but it does pollute the error log and skip the audit-log entry for every enterprise lead. Fix in /app/backend/routers/leads_router.py L183 by removing 'target_id' or matching the current log_activity signature.

Resend rejects @example.com recipients ('Invalid `to` field. Please use our testing email address instead of domains like example.com'). Cosmetic during automated tests — not a real bug in prod, but tests should switch to `delivered@resend.dev` or seed a real domain to avoid noise.

issues: When cmdk-input is empty, the spec expected `cmdk-empty` div showing 'Start typing to search users, orgs, courses…'. Actual behaviour: NAV_ITEMS tab suggestions always render (items.length > 0) so cmdk-empty is never mounted on first open. Arguably a UX upgrade (users see 8 jump-to-tab suggestions immediately) but a deviation from the spec — flag if you want the exact empty-state copy. The 'No matches.' variant does render when a >=2 char query has zero results.

React dev-mode logs 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' inside the <select> in automation-trigger-select / action-select-N. Root cause: the Emergent editor instrumentation injects x-source-* wrapper <span>s inside <option>{v.label} ({k})</option>. This is tooling noise in the preview environment — production build will not have the instrumentation. Not blocking, but consider making the option child a plain string (e.g. `${v.label} (${k})`) if you want a fully clean console.

action_items: Fix log_activity signature mismatch in /app/backend/routers/leads_router.py (~L183) — the enterprise-lead automation dispatch still works, but every submission logs a TypeError.
(nit) Decide whether Cmd-K empty state should show the tab suggestions (current behaviour) or the 'Start typing to search…' hint (spec). If spec is authoritative, hide tabMatches until user types.
critical_code_review_comments: AutomationBuilder.jsx L338/382 — `<option>{v.label} ({k})</option>` renders an interpolated string, which in dev mode is wrapped by the Emergent editor's x-source-* <span> and produces a React hydration warning. Change to `<option value={k}>{`${v.label} (${k})`}</option>` to guarantee a text-only child.

AdminCopilotPanel.jsx L118 — on abort/network error the last assistant bubble is left with `text: '(No response — check backend logs.)'` which is helpful, but the pending-bubble is never removed if the user quickly clicks copilot-reset while the stream is mid-flight — abortRef.current.abort() runs in resetSession but the aborted-request's finally clause still setBusy(false) on the OLD component ref. Consider setting an abort marker on the message itself to prevent stale updates leaking into the new session.

CommandPalette.jsx L176 — `{items.length === 0 && …}` never triggers on first-open because tabMatches is always populated, so the spec's 'Start typing to search…' empty state is effectively dead code. Either hide tabMatches when q is empty or drop the empty-state branch entirely.

admin_copilot_router.py L176-180 — the update_one() call after streaming uses `{'session_id':…, 'actor_id':…, 'created_at': {'$exists': True}}` which is not the unique key (session_id can have multiple rows). Because upsert=False and it targets *any* one row matching the filter, the assistant_reply may attach to the wrong turn on multi-turn sessions. Recommend storing the query's row id and updating by id.
